answer: A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The canyon counter is kept in sable and fable makes public each reset. An adversary thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4433 identities would post 4469 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
